text:
maria: proposing a minimal-risk rollout for tenant-scoped compact-fallback. intent: allow opt-in pilots, run a tiny internal canary, and have an automated degrade path that flips to compact variant on SLO or quality drift. looking for owners and a trimmed timeline.

maria: problem: two enterprise pilots asked for cost/burst protection and deterministic behavior under partial outage. we need per-tenant control + safe automation.

samir: infra viewpoint: we can evaluate a per-request header (x-rw-tenant-fallback) at the router and do weighted splits. runtime change: flag eval + routing hook (~3w), telemetry hook (~1w). compact model ~25-30% CPU savings in bench.

devon: SRE requirements: automated circuit breaker that trips when p99 > 2x SLO for 10m OR error-rate > 3x baseline. when tripped, route affected tenant/region to compact variant. ramp recommendation: 0.5% internal -> 2% pilot -> opt-in tenants -> hold windows 24h. auto-rollback on error-budget burn or quality regression. include synthetic prompt probes during canary.

lea: CS: pilot customers FinCo and HealthCo want opt-in. HealthCo requires EU-only processing. need console-level kill-switch per tenant and request-level logging for validation. also need clear customer notice that embeddings/outputs may differ under fallback.

carl: eng-platform: can provision an EU-only pool for HealthCo. ETA ~6 business days from green light. will add tenant-scoped logs and an allowlist for pilot tenants.

jia: telemetry: we need token-level cost deltas, latency p50/p95/p99, and an embedding-similarity quality metric for A/B samples. runtime should expose a shadow hook so we can diff outputs without affecting users.

samir: sample flag JSON (for RFC):

```
{
  "flag":"compact_fallback_v1",
  "variants":["primary-2026","compact-2026"],
  "stages":[{"name":"internal-canary","pct":0.5},{"name":"pilot-optin","pct":5}],
  "per_tenant_override":true
}
```

(We only need the router hook and a way to set per-tenant overrides.)

devon: quick runbook bullets: detect -> flip -> observe -> escalate. detection triggers: p99>threshold OR error spike OR quality score drop. action: set routing weight=100% compact for affected scope. paging rule: page on-call and product owner. record sample prompts + outputs for postmortem.

maria: decision checklist: samir implement flag + routing; carl provision EU pool; devon draft runbook + pager; lea get pilot prompts + legal signoff for EU; jia wire telemetry dashboards.

maria: proposed minimal timeline: internal canary in 7 days (0.5%), pilot opt-in in 3 weeks, regional/EU pool only for HealthCo after provisioning. prefer opt-in-first to reduce blast radius.

samir: if we must cut scope, drop the staged regional pct step and run only internal canary + opt-in tenants. less infra lift.

devon: agree. opt-in + synthetic checks is safest first run.

lea: I'll onboard pilots and collect prompt suites this week; will loop legal for EU residency confirmation.

carl: starting EU pool request today; will post ETA in #eng-infra.

jia: will draft the telemetry spec for token/cost delta + embedding-similarity scoring; need runtime shadowing hook.

maria: owners: samir (runtime/flag), carl (infra/EU pool), devon (SRE/runbook), lea (pilot/legal), jia (telemetry). I'll file the roadmap ticket and the RFC template. sync Friday 11am to confirm PRs. :white_check_mark:
